full.description: This image is a biological diagram illustrating different cell cycle pathways leading to various cellular outcomes, including continued division or cell death. The central green loop represents the active cell cycle through premitotic phases, with a cell depicted inside a nucleus. Orange pathways show cells exiting or re-entering the cycle, while the red pathway depicts a damaged cell leading directly to cell death. The schematic is commonly used to explain cellular responses to injury, stress, or regulation.

It serves as an educational model for understanding the systemic effects of chronic congestion.

random.description: This image is a colored vector diagram illustrating the cell cycle and its regulation. It shows a cyclical pathway with several checkpoints and branching paths leading toward cell differentiation, quiescence, or programmed cell death.
